summary: test_basic: /v1/models lists the model path as id. data[0].id == BAAI/bge-reranker-base via openai-serving-models.show-available-models. The /tokenize token-id assertion is tokenizer internals and untranslatable; not counted separately.

score 1 query vs 1 document: one ScoreResponseData with an id. serve-score cross-encoder branch: one classify encode per pair, build-response returns 1 item. HF score agreement is numeric (untranslatable part).
score 1 query vs N documents: N results. 2 classify encodes, 2 data items.
score N queries vs N documents: N results. 2 classify encodes, 2 data items.

score {queries, items} (ScoreQueriesItemsRequest): N results. Model reads only queries/query/text_1 and documents/text_2, so `items` gives an empty document list: 400 value-error "queries and documents must be 1:N or N:N". Code: protocol.py:105-114 maps items to data_2; api_router.py:47 accepts the ScoreRequest union.

score {text_1, text_2} lists: N results. Model sets vars.q = [input.body.text_1] without unwrapping a list, so a list text_1 becomes [[...]] and the run aborts on string + list. Code: protocol.py:117-127 accepts ScoreInput | list[ScoreInput] for text_1.
score {data_1, data_2} (ScoreDataRequest): N results. data_1/data_2 not read: 400 value-error. Code: protocol.py:84-86.
rerank 1 query vs 2 documents: 2 results with an id. post-rerank -> serve-score (prefix rerank, query field) -> build-response; relevance thresholds are numeric (untranslatable part).
rerank top_n=2 over 3 documents keeps 2. build-response slices sorted results to top_n.

rerank pair over max_model_len=100: 400 "Please reduce the length of the input prompt". tokenize-prompt correctly fails vllm-validation-error, but it runs inside the parallel branch with no on_error, so the join fails `insufficient` and the client gets 500 InternalServerError. Code: renderers/params.py:515-537 raises VLLMValidationError, which propagates to a 400 (serve/exception_handling/error_response.py:41-44).

score pair over max_model_len: 400 reduce-length; truncate_prompt_tokens=101 > 100: 400 "Please request a smaller truncation size.". First request: same 500-instead-of-400 join bug. Second: serve-score ignores truncate_prompt_tokens entirely; code checks it in TokenizeParams (renderers/params.py:270-281) built by ScoringRequestMixin.build_tok_params (scoring/protocol.py:68-74).

/invocations routes a RerankRequest to the rerank endpoint, same keys as /rerank. Model only tries chat (messages) and completion (prompt), then 400 "Cannot find suitable handler". Code: sagemaker/api_router.py:81-84 adds get_pooling_invocation_types, which includes RerankRequest, ScoreRequest and PoolingRequest when scoring is enabled (pooling/factories.py:221-272).

use_activation None/True equal; False gives raw logits with sigmoid(False) == True. Asserts tensor closeness of relevance scores (torch.allclose, F.sigmoid): numeric output below the model. (Note: serve-score also drops use_activation from pooling_params; code scoring/protocol.py:76-81.)

/pooling task=classify on a classify model: one item whose data has one value. post-pooling hardcodes task: embed and ignores body.task, so async-llm.encode refuses embed (not supported) with a 400. Code: pooling/serving.py:61-99 (_verify_pooling_task takes request.task, defaulting to the model pooling_task) and pooling/protocol.py PoolingResponse.

max_tokens_per_doc=10 lowers usage.prompt_tokens. Model ignores max_tokens_per_doc and computes num_prompt_tokens = size(q)+size(d) (count of texts, not tokens), so both requests report equal usage. Code: scoring/io_processor.py:147-161 and 641-680 truncate documents to max_tokens_per_doc tokens; usage counts prompt token ids.

max_tokens_per_doc=0 accepted; -5 is 400 "max_tokens_per_doc must be a non-negative integer". -5 succeeds in the model. Code: scoring/io_processor.py:110-112 and 139-140 raise ValueError (400 BadRequestError).

/pooling refuses embed/token_embed (Unsupported task), token_classify (Try switching pooling_task), plugin (No IOProcessor plugin installed). All four are 400 BadRequestError in the model, but every one comes from async-llm.encode with "This model does not support pooling" because the task is hardcoded to embed. Code: pooling/serving.py:76-97 gives the three distinct messages.

TestReplayWithHoldback.test_replay: every ParserEngine yields the same parsed reasoning/content/tool calls and leaks no terminal markers for any chunk size and detokenizer holdback. Token- and character-level chunk-boundary invariance of the streaming lexer (vllm/parser/engine/parser_engine.py:453 parse_delta, streaming_parser_engine.py:89) is parser internals below the model; the model has parser-engine.parse-complete only.

LLM.encode: N PoolingParams for N prompts gives N outputs; a length mismatch raises VLLMValidationError; one PoolingParams or None applies to every prompt. The matched, single and None cases pass (4 outputs), but llm.encode has no pooling_params input, so 3 params for 4 prompts succeeds. Code: pooling/base/io_processor.py:307-320 _params_to_seq raises VLLMValidationError "The lengths of prompts (4) and params (3) must be the same."

test_expanded_prompt_is_bounded: after multimodal placeholders expand, the prompt is cut again to truncate_prompt_tokens (147 -> 96), keeping the audio placeholder (offset 1, length 52) intact. No model entity covers BaseRenderer._truncate_expanded_prompt / _process_singleton (vllm/renderers/base.py:1035-1097, called at 1113 and 1130); the model renderer has tokenize-prompt, detokenize-prompt and validate-token-ids only, and no truncate_prompt_tokens handling. Missing (no scenario possible).
